## About
Renown Roofing and Construction is a roofing contractor based in Flower Mound, working on homes and businesses across the Dallas-Fort Worth area. Our owner, Adam Buttorff, and our team handle residential roofing, commercial roofing, gutters and storm damage restoration.
We're locals, and we're proud to serve the community during and after work. Our team includes licensed insurance adjusters and a certified thermographer, so your inspection is thorough and your claim gets the attention it needs. We're also active in the North Texas Roofing Contractors Association and the Lewisville Chamber of Commerce.
Our customers have given us a 4.9 rating from 339 Google reviews. Reviewers mention Adam, Bryan, Chris and Jon by name, and we'd like you to get to know them too.

## Services
- Residential Roofing: Preserve and enhance the form and function of your home.
- Commercial Roofing: Uphold the safety and integrity of your business.
- Gutters: Gutters that can handle the rain help protect your home from mold, rot and erosion around the foundation.
- Storm Damage Restoration: Help putting your roof back together after a bad storm.
- Hail Damage Repair: Repairs for roofs damaged by hail.
- Roof Replacement: One reviewer had a full roof replacement with class 4 shingles after hail damage.
- Insurance Claims: We work with you and your insurance company so the claim process stays easy and straightforward.
- Free Storm Damage Report: Ask us for a storm damage report on your roof.

## FAQ
Q: If I file an insurance claim on my roof, will my insurance go up?
A: No. In Texas, it is against the law for an insurance company to raise rates based on what they describe as an "Act of God."

Q: My roof looks good from the ground. Is it really ok?
A: You won't know until a roofing professional looks at it. Damage you can't see from the ground can still lead to leaks.

Q: Do you charge for an inspection?
A: No. Talk to one of our specialists about a free inspection and consultation for any of our services.

Q: When can I call?
A: Any time. We're open 24 hours, every day of the week.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: Communities across the Dallas area, including Flower Mound, Lewisville, Dallas, Ft. Worth, Plano, Frisco and Denton County.
